data.fund_type: An open-ended dynamic equity scheme investing across large cap, mid cap, small cap stocks
data.investment_objective: The investment objective of the scheme is to provide long-term capital appreciation from a portfolio investing predominantly in Indian equity and equity related instruments across market capitalization. However, there is no assurance that the investment objective of the Scheme will be realized
data.asset_allocation: Equity and Equity related instruments including equity linked derivatives - 65-100%; Debt securities (including securitized debt & debt derivatives) and money market instruments$ -0 - 35%; Units issued by REITs and InvITs - 0-10%
data.exit_load: I.For investors who have opted for SWP under the plan: a)15% of the units allotted(including Switch-in/STP - in)on or before completion of 365 days from the date of allotment of units: Nil. b)Any redemption in excess of such limits in the first 365 days from the date of allotment shall be subject to the following exit load: (Redemption of units would be done on First In First Out Basis (FIFO): -If redeemed within 1 year (365 days) from the date of allotment:1% -If redeemed after 1 year (365 days) from the date of allotment:NIL II.Other Redemptions: For Investors who have not opted for SWP under the plan (including Switch out, STP out): -If redeemed within 1 year (365 days) from the date of allotment:1% -If redeemed after 1 year (365 days) from the date of allotment:NIL
